page.title: Launch progress
page.purpose: Follow a launch step by step, or start a packet as it is: prepared, or unknown once the operator asserts it was never started; a failed start offers discard with a reason and relaunch as a new commission.

states.description: Created, composer ready, stance sent, ready seen, goal sent, goal verified.
A step failed: the failure, Discard with a required reason, and Relaunch.
The stance message and the goal line, read from the API, with the order to paste them; hidden while the commission is unknown until the never-started assertion is made.
The API cannot be reached or refused the read; the page names which and offers retry, and nothing else on the page pretends to know.
The page announces that it is reading the research home; nothing is shown as known until it is.
The packet has no launch record yet: the page offers Launch (behind the never-started assertion when it is unknown), or Relaunch as a new commission when the API cannot assert it.
An optional scenario is down: only the values it feeds read unknown, each with the reason; everything read from files is still shown.
A refresh failed after a good read: the earlier read stays on screen under a 'Not current' notice with its time and the reason.
